Microsoft runtime notices for the Bop It Access Installer

The self-contained Windows x64 installer includes Microsoft.NETCore.App
and Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App runtime components, version 10.0.11.
The following licence and notice files are copied byte-for-byte from the
official Microsoft NuGet runtime packs used by this installer build.
These are redistribution notices, not licences for Bop It Access itself.

https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x64/10.0.11
